info.title: automap
info.description: CI verification tool for AutoMap.Generator — `dotnet automap verify` reflects into a built assembly's generated AutoMap.AutoMapGraph.Edges and diffs it against a checked-in snapshot file, failing the build when a mapping is added, removed, or renamed unexpectedly.

options.name: --assembly
options.description:
Path to a built assembly containing an AutoMap.Generator-generated
AutoMap.AutoMapGraph class.

options.name: --snapshot
options.description: Path to a checked-in snapshot file listing expected mappings, one per line.

options.name: --update
options.description:
Write the assembly's current mappings to the snapshot file instead of
diffing against it (use when a mapping change is intentional).
